note: The first runner reads this file and opens html: that is the game hub, so the runner always lands on the three games. The hub's Pindutan chair opens arena; the arena updates itself from arena too. menu/menuBuild let the hub keep itself current. To publish a new build: put it on main as labs/pindutan-v21.html and bump build here to the same tag. To ship a new hub: bump menuBuild to the tag the new pindutan.html calls itself. Set "ladder" to a full https address to move the leaderboard to a host of its own; leave it empty to keep api-leaderboard.php on aidekupal.unaux.com.
